name: Single-file deck, define-once components
description: The deck is one self-contained HTML file organised in four layers, each defined once: (1) design tokens as CSS custom properties on :root; (2) component classes (chapter, overlay card + variants, tile, arrow, step list, notes UI); (3) one hidden <svg><defs> holding shared filters (#lift) and markers (#arr), referenced by every inline diagram via url(#id); (4) one JS engine that discovers behaviour from data-attributes (e.g. data-ambient, data-step, data-overlay, data-note) on slide markup. Slides contain only semantic content plus those attributes: no per-slide styling or scripts, no duplicated values.
justification: DRY within a single file: a rule change (colour, shadow, timing) lands in one place and applies everywhere, and design rules in docs/DESIGN.md map 1:1 to a token, class or engine feature. Rejected: per-slide inline styles/scripts as in the prototypes (already drifted, e.g. #lift opacity .11 vs .14); a framework/build step (violates no-build single-file requirement); web components (heavier, less readable for a hand-edited deck). Assumes modern evergreen browser for presenting/reading.
